activity_statements.statement: manufactures and sells decorative paints for residential and commercial buildings under the Dulux brand in 150+ countries
produces and sells high-performance marine and protective coatings (International brand) for ships, offshore platforms, and industrial infrastructure
manufactures powder and liquid coatings for automotive OEM and refinishing applications under the Sikkens and Interpon brands
operates paint and coatings manufacturing plants globally with a supply chain serving professional applicators and retail consumers
conducts R&D in coatings chemistry to develop more sustainable, lower-VOC formulations for consumer and industrial markets

name_reality_gap: none — AkzoNobel is straightforwardly a global paints and coatings manufacturer; the name and index label (Chemical Manufacturing) are consistent with reality.
extraction_notes: About page confirmed core identity and scale (32,000 employees, 150+ countries). Brand names (Dulux, International, Sikkens, Interpon) and segment structure are from well-documented public sources. Segment revenue split is approximate.
